items.d: An artificial intelligence startup founded by one of China’s most successful hedge fund managers is preparing to release its first product – the core of an operating system designed for AI agents rather than humans.

Send a tip to our reporters Site feedback: Take our Survey New Window Facebook X LinkedIn Email Link Gift By Bloomberg News November 27, 2026 at 1:29 AM UTC Bookmark Save Takeaways by Bloomberg AI An artificial intelligence startup founded by one of China’s most successful hedge fund managers is preparing to release its first product – the core of an operating system designed for AI agents rather than humans. Feng Ji, the founder of the $4 billion hedge fund Baiont Quant, is betting the program will help redefine the relationship between AI programs and the hardware needed to run them. After years of large language models making startling progress despite largely running on legacy operating systems like Windows or Linux, the idea is to write operating systems explicitly tailored for AI.

items.t: Holidays to Test AI Shopping Bots From Google, Amazon, Meta and OpenAI
items.d: Google, Amazon, Meta and OpenAI all want to help pick your holiday gifts. Whose advice will shoppers take?
items.fullText: EXCLUSIVE Technology The Big Take AI Shopping Bots Get a Shot at Proving $1 Trillion Hype This Holiday Season Google, Amazon, Meta and OpenAI all want to help pick your holiday gifts. Whose advice will shoppers take? Illustration by Jose Flores Facebook X LinkedIn Email Link Gift Facebook X LinkedIn Email Link Gift By Spencer Soper November 26, 2026 at 10:00 PM UTC Updated on November 27, 2026 at 12:40 AM UTC Bookmark Save Daniel McCarthy was scrolling through Instagram when an ad appeared targeting athletes with weak ankles. An avid runner, he was intrigued by a product promising to boost foot and ankle strength. Rather than buying it, he took a screenshot and pasted it into ChatGPT, asking if the item was worth the price and if there were better options. OpenAI’s ubiquitous bot didn’t disappoint, showing him a balancing board that it recommended as a better fit for someone who spends hours a day at a standing desk and cost about half as much. items.fullText: Into the Omniverse: How Developers Turn Ideas Into Simulations With Frontier AI Agents See how developers are combining AI agents with NVIDIA Omniverse libraries to build simulation applications, test physical behavior and guide improvements. November 19, 2026 by NVIDIA Writers 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Your browser doesn't support HTML5 video. Here is a link to the video instead. Turning a simulation idea into a working application means assembling assets, connecting physics and rendering, and checking that the scene behaves as intended. Developers are combining frontier AI models with NVIDIA Omniverse libraries to help carry out that work — building applications for exploring scenarios, investigating failures and improving designs. Developers direct AI agents through natural-language instructions, review results and guide changes. Omniverse libraries provide GPU-accelerated physics, rendering and sensor simulation capabilities. Explore the projects below to see frontier AI models such as GPT-6 Astra at work, and check back for new examples from NVIDIA teams and developers across the ecosystem. Physical AI Paves the Path to Autonomous Industrial Operations 🔗 https://blogs.nvidia.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Nyhamna_footage_take5_30s.mp4 AI agents powered by frontier models pave the way to autonomous operations. They use industrial tools and engineering data to help engineers build digital twins that test plans and processes and evaluate operational decisions. Falkor, a KONGSBERG company, shows how this works in practice. The company’s Falkor Surface platform lets customers turn their computer-aided design and engineering data into facility-scale digital twins using the GPT-6 Astra model. The platform uses NVIDIA Omniverse libraries and NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Server Edition GPUs on Microsoft Azure to enable advanced physics simulation.
